title: A locked tab opens onto who can grant it - from every door, not a 403
deviations_from_card: Critic revision applied. (1) idea-47b71431 adopted explicitly: WorkspaceTabChunks.tsx's navActive ternary chain is now `const TAB_PANELS: Record<WorkspaceTabId, (ctx) => ReactNode>` (history included, mapped to the analyze panel), and panelFor(registry, id, caps) in navCapabilities.ts is its ONLY lookup - generic over the entry so node:test drives it with a string registry; its registry parameter is Record<WorkspaceTabId, P>, pinned by a type-level assertion in navCapabilities.test.ts (a registry missing 'templates' is not assignable; tsc-checked, no @ts- suppression so no ts-debt ceiling). No registry module added - it lives where the chain did. (2) The branding case is INVERTED: tabArrival('branding', ['read']) -> {kind:'locked', needs:'org:manage'}. Rule stated in the commit, the navCapabilities.ts header block and app-structure.md: a seat whose KNOWN caps lack TAB_CAPABILITY[id] is locked on arrival at id whatever door it came through; unknown caps open every door. (3) Acceptance cases run as 18 node:test cases across three files (8 card criteria). Tests and implementation landed in one feat commit (a test-only commit would have been red at import). The catalogs + REFUSAL_ERRORS entry were committed first under the lock (c5eca55af) so the feat commit typechecks. Copy uses nav.lockedDoor.* plus the existing workspaceAdmin.members.role.* labels; the ?tab= inbox parser in Workspace.tsx is unchanged in code (comment added): it deliberately ADOPTS a capability-locked id, since the lock is decided at the destination. Route test uses a fresh workspace: the default one carries the seeded CSAS demo roster.
notes: Loop closed: every surface that offers a gated tab now agrees on one rule - rail (lock-door row via onSelect, link mode -> /?tab=<id> which lands on the lock), g-chords, ?tab= arrivals, programmatic selectTab (all render through panelFor); the palette keeps hiding locked tabs (card: unchanged); selectTab and NavSectionRail's section warm-up no longer prefetch a chunk the seat can never render. Source guard updated: tabBoundaryCoverage.test.ts pinned the old ternary arms - it now pins the registry covers every id, the single choice.panel(...) + <LockedTabPanel> render sites inside the boundary, no dynamic tab mounted outside the registry, and still forbids a navActive arm (shape fixture). recipes-sizing.test.ts caught a bare BTN_SECONDARY in the first draft (fixed). Holders route: requireCapability('read') (401/403), isCapability else jsonRefusal CAPABILITY_UNKNOWN 400, currentWorkspace(), listMembershipsForWorkspace -> resolveCapabilities(role, overrides), drops disabled users and users whose org != the workspace's org, stable owner-first sort by MEMBER_ROLES order, cap 5, {name,email,role} only; no db.ts barrel. Open/dev mode folds to owner so nothing locks and the route is never called. PERF: base c7690bd4a measured 1441/9179 KB; with only this card 1443/9193 KB (no sibling uncommitted app files in the tree at measure time); raised app/page.tsx 1441/9181 -> 1443/9194 under the lock with a why; test:perf green. tsc: clean except errors under the untracked kpi-sim/ tree (foreign, as slot A recorded). Full test:unit green (exit 0). Not visually verified in a browser (dev/build are off-limits for builders): the panel composes PANEL/CARD_PAD/ICON_TILE/EYEBROW/TITLE_DISPLAY/INTRO/META_LABEL/BTN_SECONDARY recipes and design:check is green, but a both-themes look at ?tab=billing as a viewer seat is owed at integration.
